instruction: Research across 2 sites and summarise: read the field notes on the Research Hub, then read the summary on the Reference Library, and summarise what on-device perception means for a light-weight browser agent.
summary: Summary across 2 sites. Field notes (Research Hub): a light-weight browser agent must do real work without sending the page to a server; on-device grounding keeps interaction private, and verification after every step is what makes a multi-step job trustworthy. Summary (Reference Library): on-device perception means the agent reads the page where the page lives — element detection and text extraction run locally, sensitive data is redacted before reaching a model, and every action is verified against the live page afterwards.
